# The Neshverse — llms.txt
# https://theneshverse.vercel.app

## About

The Neshverse is Neshakar Murali's personal digital ecosystem for technology, AI, digital products, design, publishing and creative systems. It is an independent platform built in public — not a portfolio, but a living record of ideas being made real.

Creator: Neshakar Murali
Location: Malaysia (2° 11' N · 102° 15' E)
Established: 2026

## Sections

- **Studio** — Completed creative and product work: MindFrame, HireFrame, FRAMEBOUND, TECHFEST 2026, AURIX XH1, ReviewFlow AI.
- **Products** — Product direction and tools in motion: MindFrame (personal digital workspace for students), HireFrame (AI-powered ATS optimisation tool).
- **Labs** — Experiments, prototypes and unfinished ideas: ReviewFlow AI, Interface Plays, Craft Automation, Systems Memo.
- **Journal** — Notes, frameworks and thinking in progress.
- **Publishing** — The AI Mastery Journey: a four-volume series on working with AI clearly and intentionally.
- **About** — Neshakar Murali, founder and creator.
- **Now** — A living snapshot of current work.
- **Future** — What Neshakar is watching in AI, technology and creative systems.

## Key Projects

### MindFrame
A custom digital workspace built around the way students think, plan and build. In progress. Category: Digital Product / AI workflows / Systems thinking.

### HireFrame
An AI-powered resume and positioning product designed to make early-career job applications more coherent and ATS-aware. Category: AI product / Resume strategy / UX.

### FRAMEBOUND
A photobook identity and visual system for preserving memories. Category: Creative direction / Typography / Visual identity.

### TECHFEST 2026
Event visual identity for TECHFEST 2026 — energetic, clear, memorable. Category: Graphic design / Event creative.

### AURIX XH1
Advertising-led product visual giving a wireless headphone hardware a deliberate presence. Category: Product visual / Graphic design.

### ReviewFlow AI
Prototype exploring how AI can support clearer thinking, review loops and structured decision-making. Category: AI / Web / Automation.

### The AI Mastery Journey
Four-volume series: Vol. I The Essentials, Vol. II The Power Toolkit, Vol. III The Workflow Engine, Vol. IV The Master Vault. Topics: AI prompting, workflows, applications, advanced problem-solving.
